consents_practice_names_link.name: consents_practice_names_link
consents_practice_names_link.value: "consents"."purpose"::text not in ('practice_link', 'report_share') or "consents"."link_id" is not null

links_active_needs_both.name: links_active_needs_both
links_active_needs_both.value: "links"."status" <> 'active' or ("links"."consent_id" is not null and "links"."person_accepted_at" is not null and "links"."practice_accepted_at" is not null)

links_open_holds_key.name: links_open_holds_key
links_open_holds_key.value: "links"."status" = 'ended' or ("links"."wrapped_key" is not null and "links"."kek_id" is not null)

links_ended_holds_nothing.name: links_ended_holds_nothing
links_ended_holds_nothing.value: "links"."status" <> 'ended' or ("links"."ended_at" is not null and "links"."ended_by" is not null and "links"."wrapped_key" is null and "links"."person_name" is null)

proposals_saved_has_record.name: proposals_saved_has_record
proposals_saved_has_record.value: "proposals"."status" <> 'saved' or ("proposals"."record_id" is not null and "proposals"."decided_at" is not null)

reports_sent_requires_consent.name: reports_sent_requires_consent
reports_sent_requires_consent.value: "reports"."status" <> 'sent' or ("reports"."sent_at" is not null and "reports"."consent_id" is not null and "reports"."recipient" is not null)
